content.text:
You are executing inside an isolated Git worktree for lcv-leo/lcv-leo.
Do the following steps strictly and concisely:
1. Verify git rev-parse --show-toplevel and entire status --json.
2. Run: entire agent add antigravity --force
3. Run: entire doctor
4. Inspect git status --porcelain and git diff. Only .agents/hooks.json (or .entire/settings.json if Entire modified it) may be changed; NEVER modify AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or temp/.
5. Stage the changed hook file(s) explicitly (never temp/) and commit using the exact prepared message file: git commit -S -F temp/commit-msg.txt (NEVER pass --no-verify).
6. Output git log -1 --show-signature --format=fuller and stop.

input.command: Remove-Item Env:GIT_DIR,Env:GIT_WORK_TREE,Env:GIT_COMMON_DIR -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; entire status --json
input.description: Verify worktree root and Entire status

input.command: entire agent add antigravity --force; "---DOCTOR---"; entire doctor
input.description: Reinstall Antigravity hooks and run doctor
